caption:
❄️ Napoleon's march on Moscow — 1812.

340,000 men crossed the Niemen in June. 4,000 came back across it. Watch the band narrow at every step: only 100,000 reached Moscow, and most of the losses came before the first snow — hunger, disease and desertion, not battle. Smolensk and Borodino were victories; they cost the army anyway.

📊 Data: Charles Minard's 1869 figurative map of the Russian campaign, redrawn.
